name: Yuusha to Eroi Nakama-tachi
original_name: 勇者とエロい仲間たち
source:
Why the hero let the jester join the party?
What did he do to persuade the priest wanting to leave the party?
What the fate of the thief arrested by a soldier of the castle?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029809.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
勇者为什么让游人加入队伍？
他做了什么，才说服想离队的僧侣留下？
被城堡士兵逮捕的盗贼，又会迎来怎样的命运？

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029809.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
